Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent made an error in Step 2 by failing to effectively access the Universe Today article located at the provided URL. Despite being directed to open the article, the agent encountered loading issues and did not attempt alternative methods to retrieve the content. This lack of initiative to fully access the article—such as adjusting the viewport, using an alternative browser, or employing other methods to retrieve the article text—prevented the extraction of the paper link and the NASA award number, leading to an incomplete and incorrect final answer.
